lines: Riley Chen
+1 (555) 010-7731 | riley.chen@example.com | example.com/in/riley-chen
Date of birth: 2 Nov 1996 | Nationality: American
EDUCATION
Northfield School of Management | MBA | Metro City, USA | Sep 2023 - Jun 2025
Lakeview University | B.A. in Economics | Lake City, USA | Sep 2014 - Jun 2018
EXPERIENCE
Harbor Payments | Associate Product Manager Intern | Metro City, USA | Jun 2024 - Aug 2024
- Improved checkout conversion by 35% after replacing the three-step flow with a one-page flow for all merchants.
- Wrote the requirements and success metrics for dispute self-service, aligning engineering, risk and support; the team shipped it two weeks ahead of plan.
- Interviewed 25 merchants and analysed six months of chargeback data to size annual chargeback losses at 1.1 million dollars, the business case that set the next quarter's roadmap priority.
- Ran weekly triage with engineering and support, closing 140 onboarding tickets over the summer and cutting the open-ticket queue by half.
- Measured the onboarding redesign by comparing merchants who opted into the new flow with those who stayed on the old one.
- Redesigned merchant onboarding around a single verification step, cutting median time to first payment from 9 days to 4 across 2,300 new merchants in the pilot region.
Crestline Logistics | Operations Analyst | Lake City, USA | Mar 2019 - Aug 2023
- Cut late deliveries from 11% to 7% by excluding weather-delayed shipments from the on-time calculation.
- Cut warehouse pick errors 30% at two sites by redesigning slotting rules with the floor supervisors and retraining 45 pickers on the new layout.
- Coordinated the quarterly S&OP review across sales, finance and operations and prepares the forecast pack for each meeting.
- Led the rollout of a route-planning tool to 3 depots, training 60 drivers and dispatchers and saving 1,800 driver hours a year.
PROJECTS
Campus Food Rescue App | Product Lead | Student Venture | Oct 2023 - Present
- Launched a surplus-food pickup app to 3,100 students with two dining halls, redistributing 9 tonnes of food that would have been thrown away in its first year.
- Launched pickup reminders after 60 user interviews showed students missed pickup windows; weekly active users grew from 400 to 1,150 over the following term.
- Set up a volunteer shift system with two dining halls, filling 95% of pickup slots each week and cutting staff cover shifts from 10 to 2 a week.
MBA Consulting Practicum | Team Lead | Regional Hospital Network | Jan 2024 - May 2024
- Held weekly working sessions with clinic managers on outpatient scheduling across the network.
- Patient intake at 4 clinics was mapped and the intake form was shortened, with the changes adopted by front-desk staff.
- Halved the time it takes a new merchant to receive a first payment, across 2,300 merchants, by redesigning onboarding.
SKILLS
Product: roadmapping, A/B testing, user interviews, requirements writing
Tools: Jira, Amplitude, Excel

items.says: The dates leave an unexplained eight-month gap between the degree and the Crestline role.
The 35% conversion increase is attributed to the replacement without a comparison design or defined metric.
items.because: A change after rollout does not show causation, and readers cannot interpret the figure without knowing what counted as conversion.

items.says: The 35% conversion increase has no baseline or measurement period.
items.because: Readers cannot judge the size of the increase or how long it took to occur.

items.says: “For all merchants” is broad and does not clarify the scope.
The two-week-early delivery result is buried after the requirements and stakeholder details.
The roadmap outcome comes after the research methods and loss estimate.
“1.1 million dollars” is a wordier number format than necessary.
“Over the summer” repeats the internship dates.
The opt-in comparison does not establish that the redesign caused an onboarding change.
items.because: Merchants who chose the new flow may differ from those who stayed on the old one.

items.says: The bullet says how the redesign was measured but not what the comparison found.
items.because: Readers cannot tell whether onboarding improved or what value the measurement had.

items.says: Changing how late deliveries are counted does not demonstrate that deliveries became more punctual.
items.because: Excluding weather-delayed shipments makes the 11% and 7% rates incomparable unless both use the same inclusion rule.

items.says: The S&OP bullet does not say what the review or forecast pack helped the business decide or achieve.
items.because: Without an outcome, its value is indistinguishable from routine meeting support.

items.says: “Prepares” is present tense in a role that ended in August 2023.
The bullet lacks evidence that the 9 tonnes would otherwise have been thrown away.
items.because: A pickup total shows how much was redistributed, not what the dining halls would otherwise have done with it.

items.says: The launch bullet does not say what product or rollout contribution you owned.
items.because: A concrete contribution would make your product skills easier to assess.

items.says: “A volunteer shift system” does not show how volunteers were organized to fill pickup slots.
“Each week” and “a week” repeat the same frequency.
The weekly sessions do not state what changed as a result.
items.because: The reader cannot tell whether they led to a decision or improvement.

items.says: “Working sessions” does not explain what you did with clinic managers.
“The intake form was shortened” does not indicate the extent of the reduction.
The passive wording hides who mapped intake and shortened the form.
The bullet assigns a merchant-onboarding result to a hospital practicum and repeats the Harbor Payments achievement.
items.because: The hospital project does not explain the merchant outcome, and the same 2,300-merchant result appears under the payment-product internship.

items.says: The onboarding change is unspecified.
items.because: The reader sees no specific step or process that changed.

items.says: “Takes” uses present tense for a completed practicum.
items.because: It conflicts with the practicum’s past dates.
